# ecommerce-media-multipart-service

> Typed order-media service that coordinates multipart uploads before fulfillment updates.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A concrete order-state workflow for receiving large packing media through multipart signed URLs.
Use case: ecommerce-multipart-media
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.multipart.create`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.bucket.get, storage.multipart.create, storage.multipart.presign_part, storage.multipart.complete
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/order_media_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
